description: Check all six state components and light time on outer epochs, exact interior knots and off-grid epochs; compare full descriptor, segment ID and coverage.
Use the maximum allowed interpolation degree on a complete grid. Compare interpolated states near both endpoints and a central off-grid epoch.
A later segment appended to a closed file wins within a shortened descriptor; the earlier segment still supplies epochs outside the overlap.
A 102-packet SPK has an actual hundredth-epoch directory entry. Resolve states on each side of the directory separator and at the final epoch.
Subtype 1 interpolates position and independent velocity observations with Lagrange polynomials at irregular epochs.
The requested degree 15 with only two packets uses a reduced Hermite window, retaining position, its derivative, independent velocity and acceleration.
The requested subtype 1 degree 15 with only two packets reduces its window to the available data.
